stories.title: Muere a los 92 años Gonzalo Suárez, creador único y zumbón en la historia del cine español

en.title: Gonzalo Suárez, creator and wit of Spanish cinema history, dies at 92
en.summary: Spanish film director Gonzalo Suárez has died at age 92. He directed 27 films including 'Remando al viento' and received the Goya de Honor in 2026.

stories.title: Los Reyes reciben a Macron en su primera visita de Estado a España

en.title: The Spanish Royal Couple receives Macron on his first State visit to Spain
en.summary: King Felipe and Queen Letizia received French President Emmanuel Macron and his wife Brigitte at the Royal Palace in Madrid during his first official state visit to Spain.

stories.title: Muere el cineasta Gonzalo Suárez a los 92 años

en.title: Filmmaker Gonzalo Suárez dies at 92
en.summary: Spanish filmmaker Gonzalo Suárez died in Madrid at age 92. Over six decades he worked as a writer, screenwriter, director, producer, journalist and actor, blending cinema and literature throughout his career.

stories.title: La Audiencia de Barcelona amnistía la desobediencia de Marta Rovira por el 1-O

en.title: Barcelona Court grants amnesty to Marta Rovira for disobedience related to 1-O
en.summary: Barcelona's Provincial Court granted amnesty to Marta Rovira, former ERC secretary general, regarding charges of disobedience for her role in organizing the 1-O referendum.

stories.title: Muere Gonzalo Suárez, referente del cine y la literatura españoles, a los 92 años

en.title: Gonzalo Suárez, Spanish cinema and literature reference, dies at 92
en.summary: Gonzalo Suárez, a prominent Spanish filmmaker and writer known for films including 'Remando al viento' and 'Ditirambo', has died at age 92. He was also an accomplished sports journalist and received the Goya de Honor award in February.

stories.title: La Audiencia de Barcelona amnistía a Marta Rovira (ERC) por la organización del 1-O

en.title: Barcelona Court amnestied Marta Rovira (ERC) for organizing the 1-O
en.summary: The Barcelona Court has applied criminal amnesty to Marta Rovira for disobedience charges related to her participation in the illegal 2017 referendum. The amnesty applies to the case that was open against her.

stories.title: Marta Rovira, amnistiada por desobediencia por la organización del 1-O

en.title: Marta Rovira amnestied for disobedience for organizing the 1-O
en.summary: The Barcelona Court has applied criminal amnesty to Marta Rovira for her role in organizing the 1-O referendum, more than two months after receiving approval from the European Court of Justice.

stories.title: El decreto de vivienda del Gobierno: prórroga de los contratos de alquiler, el Estado como prestamista de las familias y rebaja del IVA a la construcción

en.title: Government housing decree: extension of rental contracts, the State as family lender and VAT reduction on construction
en.summary: The Spanish Government announced a reduction in VAT to 4% for public and protected housing construction and created a new program called Tu Casa where the State acts as lender to rental families seeking to purchase homes.

stories.title: La Reina Letizia contraataca el Louis Vuitton de Brigitte Macron con un diseño de Pertegaz e Isabel Díaz Ayuso pone el toque taurino en el comienzo de la visita de Estado del presidente francés

en.title: Queen Letizia counters Brigitte Macron's Louis Vuitton with a Pertegaz design as Isabel Díaz Ayuso adds a bullfighting touch to the start of the French president's state visit
en.summary: Emmanuel Macron and the First Lady of France begin a two-day state visit to Spain. The Spanish Queen and regional leaders wore notable fashion choices for the official reception.

stories.title: Los Reyes reciben a Macron con todos los honores en su primera visita de Estado a España

en.title: The Spanish Royals receive Macron with full honors on his first state visit to Spain
en.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron arrived at the Royal Palace for a state visit marked by ceremonial traditions including cavalry, trumpets, lancers, and a 21-gun salute.

stories.title: PSOE y Sumar salvan un acuerdo en Vivienda con dos decretos que Moncloa quiere convalidar de urgencia en el Congreso este viernes

en.title: PSOE and Sumar reach a housing agreement with two decrees that the government wants to validate urgently in Congress this Friday
en.summary: Spanish coalition partners PSOE and Sumar agreed on housing-related measures after initial disagreements. The government plans to expedite approval of two decrees through Congress.

stories.title: El Gobierno aprueba un decreto con la prohibición de desahucios hasta 2030 y otro con la prórroga automática de los alquileres

en.title: The Government approves a decree prohibiting evictions until 2030 and another with automatic lease extensions
en.summary: The Spanish government passed two housing-related decrees, one with expected support from Junts and PNV and another without sufficient votes for validation.

stories.title: Burnham reformará las pensiones y buscará una relación más cercana con la UE

en.title: Burnham to reform pensions and seek closer EU relationship
en.summary: The prime minister pledges to reverse Thatcher-era restrictions on water company ownership and will examine changes to the current electoral system.

stories.title: Sabadell reforma sus centros corporativos de Madrid, Sant Cugat y Alicante

en.title: Sabadell reforms its corporate centers in Madrid, Sant Cugat and Alicante
en.summary: The bank is restructuring its corporate facilities in three locations and plans to build a new project hub adjacent to its Sant Cugat offices.

stories.title: El Ibex pierde los 19.600 puntos pendiente de Irán y la inflación

en.title: Ibex loses 19,600 points pending Iran and inflation developments
en.summary: Oil price pressure and debt interest concerns weigh on markets awaiting macroeconomic data, with the Ibex seeking stabilization following previous declines.

stories.title: Indra, Santa Bárbara, EM&E y SAPA entrega nueve blindados 'Dragón' más a Defensa y llega a las 100 unidades

en.title: Indra, Santa Bárbara, EM&E and SAPA deliver nine additional Dragon armored vehicles to Defense, reaching 100 units
en.summary: The consortium delivers more armored vehicles to the defense ministry and expects to complete its commitment of 348 units by the end of 2028.

stories.title: El precio del petróleo y los bonos del Tesoro de EEUU mantienen su relación más estrecha desde 1990

en.title: Oil price and US Treasury bonds maintain their closest relationship since 1990
en.summary: Bond investors are closely monitoring the Iran conflict and crude oil prices to assess trends in government financing costs.
